single_language_rule: Every term you read in the availability map is spelled exactly the same way in `conditions[].dimension` (when it is conditionable) and in `required_capabilities`. There is no second vocabulary and no translation for you to perform.

competition.desc: Restrict the cohort to the upcoming fixture's competition, or any.

expected_formation.desc: Announced or predicted formation for the upcoming fixture. Not provided by the source.

formation_recorded_history.desc: How much of the prior history carries a recorded formation. Coverage alone tells you how reliable a formation question would be; conditioning on formation additionally requires match_level_observations.

half_time_score_state.desc: Split by the score at half time. No half-level data exists in this corpus, so no packet can support it.

historical_venue_conditioning.desc: Split the subject's PRIOR matches by where they were played. Requires venue-split evidence in this packet. This is NOT the same as knowing which side is at home in the upcoming fixture -- that is `target_fixture_venue_context`, and it does not license this split.

injuries.desc: Availability of individual players. Not provided by the source.

lineup.desc: Starting eleven. Provided by the source but not derivable point-in-time safe, so it is withheld.

market_prices.desc: Odds or prices of any kind. Never provided to this layer by design.

match_level_observations.desc: One row per prior match, per team, with every canonical metric. The lossless view of the history.

match_period.desc: Restrict to a half of the match. No half-level split exists in this corpus, so no packet can support it.

minute_level_events.desc: Timed events within a match. Not provided by the source.

opponent_formation_family.desc: Structural family of the OPPONENT's recorded formation in each prior match. Requires a recorded formation on each observation.

opponent_profile.desc: Split the subject's prior matches by a band of the opponent faced, on one named measured axis. `axis` is REQUIRED for this term and forbidden for every other.

own_formation_family.desc: Structural family of the subject's RECORDED formation in each prior match. Requires a recorded formation on each observation.

player_ratings.desc: Per-player performance ratings. Not provided by the source.

recent_window_summaries.desc: Short-window summaries (W5, W10) alongside the long-run one, which is what makes a recent-versus-long-run question answerable.

referee.desc: Split by match official. The adapter surfaces no referee field for this corpus, so no packet can support it.

target_fixture_venue_context.desc: Which side of the UPCOMING fixture is at home. A fact about the fixture, stated in TARGET_FIXTURE_CONTEXT, always available in every packet. It does NOT let you split prior matches by venue -- see `historical_venue_conditioning`.

weather.desc: Match conditions. Not provided by the source.

xg.desc: Expected goals as published by the provider. See METRIC_SEMANTICS for what it counts and what is excluded.
